readings.Aries: Leadership is not volume. Today, the quieter approach covers more ground. The first instinct was right.
readings.Taurus: The tension you're feeling is between what you have and what you want. They are not mutually exclusive. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Gemini: Your flexibility is a gift to others and sometimes a burden to yourself. Draw a line. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Cancer: The shell is not the whole organism. Let someone see the rest. The first instinct was right.
readings.Leo: There is something you've been brave about that you haven't acknowledged to yourself. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Virgo: You have been useful to everyone except yourself today. Correct this. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Libra: The thing you've been putting off deciding has already been decided by your inaction. Notice this. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Scorpio: You've been managing your own depth to avoid frightening people. Today, someone can handle it. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Sagittarius: Your restlessness is valid. Right now, it is also the thing keeping you from what you want. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Capricorn: Something about how you're spending your time is no longer aligned with what you say you value. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Aquarius: Your ability to see the long arc is a gift. Today requires seeing the next five minutes. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Pisces: There is a vision you've had repeatedly that is trying to become real. Give it some of your practical attention. You already have what you need to take the next step.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
